reproduction.working_directory: A separate clean checkout at original_base for each variant. Do not combine the two alternative patches.
reproduction.source_identity: Verify source-patches.json and the recorded inventory after applying. Historical v2 patch includes the experimental Node wiring; production isolation is a later state.
reproduction.build_commands: Use the selected variant build_argv from the checkout root; substitute TARGET with CARGO_TARGET_DIR (or checkout/target). Both arms are built in the same executable.
reproduction.dependency_preparation: Cargo.lock dependencies must already be cached for --offline; retain any dependency setup failures. Rust 1.95.0 is required.
reproduction.measurement_protocol: Run each planned campaign once, retaining stdout JSON/JSONL and stderr even on failure. For v2 run standard wall then allocation sequentially with other task-owned CPU work paused. Do not retry for a passing threshold.
reproduction.failure_handling: Keep partial JSONL, process exit, timeout and stderr. Missing completion, root mismatch, retention violation or counter overflow invalidates the campaign; do not emit a summary pass.
reproduction.new_runs_are_new_evidence: Recorded binary SHA256 identifies these observations; rebuilt binaries and host timings may differ. No reproduction command was run while assembling this package.
